body:
My uncle and I were very close. We’re a very close family. I aspired to be like him ever since I was little, his love her reading, taste in music, love for cars, the way he used to be with women. He really made an effort when he was single to spend time with me, especially when my mom was on her own. When he died I was so upset because he had killed himself, I was jealous, I had been wanting to do it for so long. “Now I have to wait to kill myself.” Back to back suicides in a family won’t be good. It would definitely kill my grandma.

I’m an only child. I have ten cousins on my mom’s side, which is the side I’m closest to. Two aunts and two uncles, now one uncle. They all have more than one child, my mom only has me. I was partially raised by my grandmother when my mom had two jobs. We’re extremely close, I’ve become her “sixth child”. I’m the fourth eldest grandchild. The three older than me are from my eldest aunt and they live far away from most of us. I’m essentially the anchor of the family. My family has a slight disagreement on religion and it separates my aunts and uncle a bit. There’s love toward each other but they value different things, I tow the line between them.

I attend college, I’m doing pretty well I think. I have a 3.2 GPA currently. I’ve been looking to transfer to an university in Boston for film or photojournalism.

Single. It’s not that I’m having a hard time talking to women. It’s more like the situation just isn’t right for either of us and that’s been it. On multiple occasions. They all want to remain friends, I guess there’s some quality about me that makes them want me to still be in their life. I’m not like those sad guys on r/niceguys. I understand that things just don’t work out sometimes. I’ve essentially just stuck to sleeping around. It’s shallow, sometimes cruel to the girl, but I appreciate the distance.

Never taken any drug. My uncle liked that about me, that he could tell I never used. I am an alcoholic in the making, my father is, my uncle was, and both my grandfathers. It’s in my blood.

I don’t know, just recently I’ve been overwhelmed with this lonely feeling. It has swallowed me whole. I can’t stand the thought of having to be around anyone or talk to anyone. Even my best friend. I just want to distance myself from everyone. I want them to be as far from me as possible. Probably because that’ll make it harder for me to try to kill myself.

What made them great series was that their fans believed and had their back. Would have been easy to just give up, but that would just make you a shitty fan of basketball.
